references.text: The same chapter emphasizes the importance of keeping the Lord's laws and statutes, which are the foundation of life.
The foreigner shall be treated as a native-born citizen, and the same laws apply to both groups.
Repeats the command to keep all the Lord's statutes and laws to avoid being cut off from the land.
One and the same law shall apply to the foreigner and the native-born.
One law shall apply to the native-born and to the foreigner living among the Israelites.
The same statute and rule shall apply to the congregation and to the foreigner living among them.
Israel is urged to keep the laws and statutes that the Lord has given them.
The command to keep the Lord's commands, laws, and statutes in order to live long in the land.
The prophet Ezekiel repeats that Israel did not follow the Lord's statutes and did not keep his laws.
